description: Forward an existing message to another channel using Discord's native forward, which links back to the original message. The forward carries a snapshot of the content, embeds and attachments, without the original author. Works across text channels and threads. Discord forwards only regular messages, replies and command responses, not polls, and refuses a message whose content the bot cannot read (error 160014). Use discord_send_message to compose new content instead. Requires the View Channel and Read Message History permissions in the source channel and Send Messages in the target channel. Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the source message.

message_id.description: ID of the message to forward.

target_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the destination channel or thread.

name: discord_forward_message
